searchText: Why didn't the transfer work? Is it dead? Is it safe to simply assume the max hashrate drop to be ~50% (coordinating >50% hash power makes 51% attack possible) to adjust the final TTD accordingly? Eg. schedule TTD to hit 2 weeks later -> max 4 weeks until merge (2 weeks *2). It seems no validators have been activated on kiln since 2 month ago. Query your local node for up to date info, the Kiln beaconchain explorer is having issues processing deposits I see thanks 🙂 query your node like this: ``` curl -s http://127.0.0.1:5052/eth/v1/beacon/states/head/validators/<public-key-here> | jq ``` That is probably the case. It's been 5 days and my first is pending, second one is pending for 3 days, and third one is pending for 2 days. Not sure what to do at this point.
